instruction: Set Evince as the default application for opening PDF files on your Ubuntu system.

metadata.explanation: Task requires setting Evince as the default PDF viewer on Ubuntu. The evaluator uses a custom getter that queries xdg-mime for the application/pdf MIME type and returns the default application. The metric checks if the result includes 'evince.desktop'. This task is similar in difficulty and complexity to the original VLC task, requiring the same type of system configuration change.

llm_judge_reasons: Getter correctly extracts default PDF viewer using xdg-mime query on Ubuntu
Metric check_include_exclude appropriately verifies presence of 'evince.desktop' in result
Expected value 'evince.desktop' is semantically correct for Evince application
Complete coverage: single requirement (set Evince as default PDF viewer) is fully verified
Data flow is correct: getter returns desktop file name, metric checks for expected value
Metric parameter handling is correct: uses 'rules' parameter matching framework's get_rule behavior
